claims.text: Preferences
Language, units, temperature scale and number formatting.
claims.note: The four fields are Language, Units of Measure, Temperature Scale, and Group and Decimal Separator (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:237, :241, :248, :252).

claims.text: Language, units, temperature and number formatting.
claims.note: See preferences/tile/2.

claims.text: These belong to you, not to the site.
claims.note: Preferences are saved to the user record (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:490; dash-user-manager.service.ts:84). The other tabs are saved to the site (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:486).

claims.text: Settings › Preferences
claims.note: Preferences is the fourth rail entry. Its description literal is "Configure calculation preferences" (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:56), the same as Calculation's, though the tab holds no calculation settings. The separate User Preferences toolbar button is commented out on production (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:74-80), so Settings is the only route.

claims.text: The Spatial Adjust dashboard, at /spatialadjust.
claims.note: Start state. The Spatial Adjust route is /spatialadjust (app-routing.module.ts:19-23); same wording as dashboard-overview/where/1.

claims.text: The Settings dialog.
claims.note: Start state. The Settings dialog is open, and the tab to select is Preferences, the last of its left column (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:52-57, :59).

claims.text: The gear button at the right of the toolbar opens it.
claims.note: Start state. The gear button at the right of the toolbar opens Settings (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:69-72).

claims.text: A Spatial Adjust account.
claims.note: Start state. A Spatial Adjust account, as in dashboard-overview/before/1.

claims.text: Preferences belong to your account, not to the site.
claims.note: Start state. Preferences are stored against the user account (preferences/before/1).

claims.text: Preferences are stored against your user account; the calculation settings on the other tabs are stored against the site.
Open the Preferences tab
In the left rail, select [[Preferences]], the last entry.
claims.note: Preferences is the last entry of the hardcoded rail (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:52-57). The rail names are hardcoded English.

claims.text: The right side shows [[Language]], [[Units of Measure]], [[Temperature Scale]] and [[Group and Decimal Separator]].
claims.note: The Preferences pane shows four dropdowns: STRINGS.LANGUAGE, STRINGS.UNITS_OF_MEASURE, STRINGS.TEMPERATURE_SCALE and STRINGS.GROUP_AND_DECIMAL_SEPARATOR (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:236-254; en-us.json:777, :1039, :1016, :733).

claims.text: If there is no left rail, Settings is not open.
claims.note: The left rail is part of the Settings dialog, which the gear button opens (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:69-72, :107-112; sa-settings-dlg.component.html:21-30).

claims.text: Select the gear button, [[Settings]], at the right of the toolbar.
claims.note: The left rail is part of the Settings dialog, which the gear button opens (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:69-72, :107-112; sa-settings-dlg.component.html:21-30).

claims.text: These choices belong to you, not to the site.
claims.note: These four choices are saved with the user's preferences, not the site settings (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:486, :490).

claims.text: Settings dialog, Preferences tab.
Choose your units
claims.note: Step title (preferences/2/1 reworded).

claims.text: Choose your units in [[Units of Measure]].
claims.note: STRINGS.UNITS_OF_MEASURE "Units of Measure" is a dropdown of Imperial and Metric (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:240-243; dash-user-manager.service.ts:180-189; en-us.json:1039).

claims.text: The box shows the units you chose.
claims.note: The dropdown is bound to the user preference unitsSystem (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:240-243).

claims.text: The amounts on the [[Calculation]] tab change after you save and reopen Settings.
claims.note: The unit conversion runs when the dialog opens, not when the dropdown changes (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:354-365). So the amounts on the Calculation tab keep their old units until Settings is opened again after a save (preferences/2/4, now this sentence).

claims.text: If you change Units of Measure and save in the same visit, the saved amounts are rescaled by 25.4.
claims.note: Safety-critical correction kept (docs/text-corrections.md). The amounts are loaded in the user units at open (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:354-365) and converted back with the unit selected at save time (:421-427). A unit change saved in the same visit therefore stores the old-unit figures as though they were already in the new unit, which rescales them by 25.4 either way, and also triggers a recalculation (:452-455). The "Check after switching." callout below the step still carries the same warning.

claims.text: Reopen [[Settings]] and check Daily Max Amount and Lynx Reference Amount before you push.
claims.note: Safety-critical correction kept (docs/text-corrections.md). The amounts are loaded in the user units at open (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:354-365) and converted back with the unit selected at save time (:421-427). A unit change saved in the same visit therefore stores the old-unit figures as though they were already in the new unit, which rescales them by 25.4 either way, and also triggers a recalculation (:452-455). The "Check after switching." callout below the step still carries the same warning.

claims.text: Units of Measure drives the labels and precision on the Calculation tab.
claims.note: The unit abbreviation in both amount labels follows Units of Measure (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:357-359).

claims.text: Check after switching. Changing Units of Measure and saving in the same visit does not re-convert the amounts already on the Calculation tab — they are saved as though they were already in the new unit, which rescales them by 25.4.
claims.note: Imperial to metric stores the inch figures as millimetres (25.4 times smaller). Metric to imperial stores the millimetre figures as inches (25.4 times larger). Either way the amounts have changed, so the save also triggers a recalculation (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:452-455).

claims.text: After a unit change, save, then reopen Settings and check Max Amount and Lynx Reference Amount before you push anything.
claims.note: Reopening converts the stored millimetres with the new unit, so the rescaled values are visible and can be corrected before a push.

claims.text: Choose your language
claims.note: Step title (reworded).

claims.text: Choose your language in [[Language]].
claims.note: STRINGS.LANGUAGE "Language" is a dropdown of the supported languages (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:236-239; dash-user-manager.service.ts:130-166; en-us.json:777).

claims.text: The box shows your choice, and the screen switches to it when you save.
claims.note: Saving a new language re-applies the translations across the site without a reload (dash-user-manager.service.ts:84-101).

claims.text: If some text stays in English after you save, the product has no translation for it.
claims.note: Anything Spatial Adjust has no translation for stays in English, and every language other than English has gaps (app-initializer.service.ts:38; the per-locale catalogues cited in preferences/3/4).

claims.text: The tab names in the left rail are always English.
claims.note: The tab names in the settings rail are hardcoded English (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:52-57; sa-settings-dlg.component.html:27-28).

claims.text: Language, units, temperature scale and separator.
claims.note: The caption's "separator" is the Group and Decimal Separator field.

claims.text: Choose the temperature scale
claims.note: Step title (reworded). Temperature Scale is a Preferences dropdown (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:247-250).

claims.text: Choose a scale in [[Temperature Scale]].
claims.note: STRINGS.TEMPERATURE_SCALE "Temperature Scale", shown title-case, is a dropdown of Celsius and Fahrenheit (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:247-250; dash-user-manager.service.ts:169-178; en-us.json:1016).

claims.text: The box shows the scale the weather strip will use.
claims.note: The weather strip converts its temperature with the user scale (sa-weather-tb.component.ts:142-143; user-format.service.ts:56-63, :76-77).

claims.text: If the weather strip still shows the old scale later, the change was not saved.
claims.note: The choice is saved with Save Changes, which stores the user preferences when they differ (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:186-215, :482-491; sa-settings-dlg.component.html:48-55).

claims.text: Choose it again and select [[Save Changes]].
claims.note: The choice is saved with Save Changes, which stores the user preferences when they differ (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:186-215, :482-491; sa-settings-dlg.component.html:48-55).

claims.text: Temperature Scale, at the top right of the Preferences tab.
claims.note: Figure caption. Temperature Scale is in the right column of the Preferences pane, at the top (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:246-250).

claims.text: Choose the number format
claims.note: Step title. Group and Decimal Separator is a Preferences dropdown (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:251-254).

claims.text: Choose a format in [[Group and Decimal Separator]].
claims.note: STRINGS.GROUP_AND_DECIMAL_SEPARATOR "Group and Decimal Separator" is a dropdown (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:251-254; en-us.json:733).

claims.text: The box shows how numbers will be written, either 1,000.00 or 1.000,00.
claims.note: The two choices are labelled 1,000.00 and 1.000,00 (dash-user-manager.service.ts:206-215).

claims.text: If numbers still look the same after you save, check that the box shows the format you want.
claims.note: The choice is saved with the user preferences and applied by the user-format service, which formats the numbers on the screen (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:482-491; sa-table-card.component.ts:252-256, :372-388).

claims.text: The format changes how every number on the screen is written, which matters most in the table.
claims.note: Reworded from preferences/4/2: the separator changes how every number on the screen is punctuated, which matters most in the dense table columns (sa-table-card.component.ts:252-256, :372-388).

claims.text: Group and Decimal Separator, under Temperature Scale.
claims.note: Figure caption. Group and Decimal Separator is the second dropdown of the right column (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:251-254).

claims.text: Save your preferences
claims.note: Step title. Save Changes is the first button in the dialog footer (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:48-55).

claims.text: Select [[Save Changes]] at the bottom of the dialog.
claims.note: SPATIAL_ADJUST.SAVE_CHANGES "Save Changes" is in the dialog footer (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:48-55; en-us.json:459).

claims.text: The dialog closes, and the screen uses your new choices.
claims.note: A successful save closes the dialog (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:107-112; sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:186-215), and the new preferences apply across the screen (dash-user-manager.service.ts:84-101; sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:170-172).

claims.text: If a message says Unable to save data, the save failed and the dialog is still open.
claims.note: On a failed save the dialog stays open and the generic save-error message, "Unable to save data", is shown (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:208-214; dash-message.service.ts:30-33; en-us.json:165-166).

claims.text: Select [[Save Changes]] again.
claims.note: On a failed save the dialog stays open and the generic save-error message, "Unable to save data", is shown (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:208-214; dash-message.service.ts:30-33; en-us.json:165-166).

claims.text: One save keeps the edits on every tab of Settings.
claims.note: Reworded from preferences/1/6: Save Changes saves the edits on every tab of Settings together (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:186-215, :445-468).

claims.text: Save Changes, at the bottom of the Settings dialog.
claims.note: Figure caption. Save Changes is the first button of the dialog footer (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:48-55).

claims.text: Check the weather strip
claims.note: Step title (reworded from preferences/4/1).

claims.text: Look at the weather strip at the left of the toolbar.
claims.note: The weather strip is the first block of the toolbar's left group, beside the site name and course (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:21-24).

claims.text: Temperatures show in the scale you chose.
claims.note: Reworded from preferences/4/3: the weather strip follows the temperature scale (sa-weather-tb.component.ts:142-143).

claims.text: If they show the old scale, open Settings again and check [[Temperature Scale]] on the [[Preferences]] tab.
claims.note: Temperature Scale is on the Preferences tab, which opens from the gear button (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:247-250; sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:52-57).

claims.text: The weather strip follows your temperature scale.
Amount fields on the Calculation tab show the unit you chose.
The weather strip shows your temperature scale.
